answer: Got it — I've saved that as a standing convention: library crates use `thiserror`, binaries use `anyhow`, never swapped. I'll apply it in future Rust work on this codebase.

memories.content: In this codebase, library crates must use the thiserror crate for error types, and binary crates must use the anyhow crate for error handling — never the reverse (thiserror in binaries or anyhow in libraries).
